items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Then, then he and I worked on dance jobs together too

ctx.x: Was that Sunset or any place?

See, the Sunset, I think it was, I think it was with Carol, I believe. Might have been with him. Was it Cal? Yeah, I think it was Cal. Then, then he and I worked on dance jobs together too, Dominick. Remember making any records when Nanny was on the date? No, I, that, that's what I was just trying to think. I can't, can't remember making any, any records with, uh, with Dominick. No, I don't remember making any records with Dominick.

Were there any other bands that you made records with that you can remember? Uh, no. No, there's, uh, now, let's see, oh no, uh, with this, uh, O'Brien, now, I don't know who had that band, I don't know what, that was his band?
